note: Every usable shot of Rockstar's official GTA VI videos, described and tagged by hand from contact sheets. Times are seconds in the YouTube upload named by `src`. place: the region the frame shows (vice_city, leonida_keys, grassrivers, port_gellhorn, ambrosia, mount_kalaga), null when it can't be told; place_guess is then the best region (absent when nothing in the frame points to one). scene: shots of the same location and moment share it. text: the words written on screen ('' if none; [brackets] = a graphic with no words, like a logo or the game HUD). dated: shows a release or pre-order date other than November 19, 2026. bg: good calm background footage (no lead, no story action, no words on screen; with hud: the game HUD shows, a last resort). hud: where the game HUD (or another UI drawn over the picture: social post, news ticker, phone camera) sits, element -> corner or corners (minimap bottom-left; prompts, race info, character switch bottom-right; health top-left; weapon and wanted stars top-right), checked on 2+ frames of every shot; absent when none. Never put a graphic over a corner the HUD uses. lb =letterbox bars [top, bottom] in px at 1080p (null: measure it with ffmpeg cropdetect). violence: 0 none, 1 weapon or chase, 2 graphic. hook_ok: false = keep it out of the first 7.5 s. unsure_who: a lead may be in the shot but isn't confirmed: never name a person over that shot. No footage ships with this file: use your own copies of the official videos. Footage and images: Rockstar Games.
